---
applyTo: "**/*modbus*,**/*register*,**/*rs485*"
---


Never guess a register or write value. Record source/version, model/firmware, documented and client address, function code, type, words, signedness, endian/word order, scale, unit, range, access and sign. Confirm unit ID and address base. Use a single connection owner, serialized access, timeouts and backoff. Writes require verified documentation, current-value backup, rollback and explicit human confirmation.
